sections.heading: The Need
sections.text: Aurora Harbor's community learning center was damaged in a synthetic storm. Residents lack a safe space for education and growth.

sections.heading: Our Plan
sections.text: Nova Reed's plan includes new books, study tables, accessible lighting, and shared workshops to revive the center.

sections.heading: Your Impact
sections.text: Your support will provide a welcoming environment for learning, empowering the community to thrive and reach new heights.
